entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Nacatl leonin planeswalker native to Naya on Alara, whose planeswalker spark ignited after his brother's murder.

entities.name: Jazal
entities.description: Ajani's brother, whose death filled Ajani with rage.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker Ajani met on Jund, who showed him volcanic red magic.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard of Alara suffused with red, white, and green mana; Ajani's home.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Shard of Alara adjacent to Naya, where Ajani first planeswalked and met Sarkhan Vol.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane whose shards include Naya and Jund.

events.summary: Ajani discovers that his brother has been killed.
events.quote: after Ajani discovered his brother was killed

events.summary: Ajani makes his first planeswalk, to the shard of Jund, and meets Sarkhan Vol, who teaches him red magic to express his rage.
events.quote: On Jund Ajani met the planeswalker Sarkhan Vol

relations.quote: the death of his brother, Jazal
Ajani is actually a Nacatl leonin native to Naya

relations.note: Naya is a shard of Alara.
